elements.caption: One shared EChartsGateway is sufficient for all ECharts chart instances. When adding further charts, select the existing gateway instead of creating another one.

items.caption: Choose the Gauge layout and its independent ECharts theme. Automatic follows the Symcon design.
Positions use a clock face: 0° is at the top and angles increase clockwise. Preset keeps the geometry and pointer supplied by the selected Gauge preset.

Custom SVG pointers require a tightly fitted viewBox and path-only geometry and should face upward. At 100% pointer width their proportions are retained. SVG/default uses data-echarts-pivot or bottom center. Custom percentages place the native ECharts anchor at the selected point.
The hub remains attached to the pointer pivot. Preset preserves the selected Gauge layout; other shapes explicitly override its hub.
Custom hub SVGs use the same secured path-only import as custom pointers. A tightly fitted viewBox is recommended.
Theme colors remain active by default. Custom colors override only the Gauge roles listed below.
All values range from 50% to 150% of the selected preset. 100% restores the preset default.
